question: A cistern of dimensions 100 cm × 80 cm × 120 cm is fitted with an inlet pipe and an outlet pipe. The inlet pipe pours in 2000 cm³ of water per minute and the outlet pipe can empty the full tank in 3 hours and 20 minutes. If the tank is full and both pipes are open, then how many hours will it take to empty the cistern?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume = 100 × 80 × 120 = 9,60,000 cm³

Outlet Rate = 9,60,000 ÷ 200 min = 4800 cm³/min

Net Emptying Rate = 4800 − 2000 = 2800 cm³/min

Time = 9,60,000 ÷ 2800 = 40/7 hours = 5 ⁵/₇ hours

**∴ The correct option is A.**
